故事模式没等来，角色形象先改了。据说！据说！据说！是直接搬starbound的MOD角色被逮捕了，新形象好难看。 -------------- [strike] 上来就死档的游戏还真头会见。 [/strike] 现在不会死档了，最低任务等级已经下修到1了。 游戏就是氪金手游那一套，抽人物武器再编队打关卡，有每日boss和商店。不过实际上并没有需要氪金的地方，物资全部在关卡中产出。顺利的话3个小时就能抽出所有角色并全持有全金色武器，能够击败最高等级关卡（应该不大于70级）。 为什么会死档呢，因为这游戏的主线关卡等级和游戏等级相同，游戏等级提升主线关卡难度也会提升，而且即使战斗失败等级也是会上涨的。初期只有2人1把枪，必须不死人过关才能拿到资金。也就是说前5级没拿到足够的钱抽卡提升队伍，之后就TM打不过了。主线关卡等级不会下降，随机关卡最低也有15级。此时直接删除游戏数据就好了

Whilst I did have low expecation but the game is kind of rough (gameplay). There 2 gamemodes, the turn based and autobattle, I'll list my complaint for both game mode [h1]1. Gamemode - Turn Based [/h1] [h2]1.1. Order of Turn[/h2] Who goes first is pure random, you can start a round with 1 turn for you and multiple turn for the enemies and opposite is true too. This feel awful since you have no contorl on the outcome at all. What you want to use the machine gunner/ rocketeer for their ability? Too bad they only get to go at the rear end of the battle. In 3x3 formation, the first pawn to go is the rear colum guy who can't move because they only move 2 square (unless it infiltrator who can go 4 sq), they lack range too? Too bad that guy is essentially useless and you lose a turn. You try to focused on a enemy unit before it their turn, but which one they both look the same, is it the one at back or the one at front? You'll have to guess. You won not because the you strategize and execute a plan perfectly, is just the game feels like it feel unsatisfying. I suggest certain class of pawn have higher movement and take priotiy first, adding 2 more row for not getting body blocked due to bad placement, highlight the unit whose you're targetting to know who to prioritise. [h2]1.2. Mechanic[/h2] [h3]1.2.1. Jam[/h3] Have to be the worst mechanic to introduce, you try finishing off an enemy oh wait your gun jammed and now you're dead. Whilst is true attatctment affect reliability, it seem to discourage you putting anything on since everything lower reliabity of your gun. I would prefer a critcal chance, it would feel less annoying than doing no damage at all. [h3]1.2.2. Defense[/h3] It put a pawn into defensive mode, where they will take no damage from attack, this can be nice someitme when you use it, but feel awful when used by the enemy especially near the end. You have to wait for their defense state to expire only then can you damage them, it just drag out a battle unnecessary. Have it reduce incoming damage instead of outright zero damage. [h3]1.2.3. Movement[/h3] As mentioned in order of turn pawn cannot move into square that contain another pawn, but this also apply to dead body too, if you order them to into that square with a dead body they refuse to move, you lose a action too. Deadbody shouldn't block movement, if the map is too small add more column to incesstiving more mobility unit. [h3]1.2.4. Pawn ability[/h3] Most of them feel extremly underwhelming, rifleman in theory score more hit but there barely any different to just normal fire. Infiltrator high mobility is neat if you have melee only otherwise kind of pointless. (unless distance affect accaury but I can't confirm that) Riot pawn with shield, in the game pawn doesn't block line of fire anyone can hit the rear line if they're in range, it only protect rear unit when it activate it skill which is never used by the enemy, they might as well not exisit since they don't any damage anyway. Just give them normal gun or allow sidearm to do minor damage. [h1]2. Game Mode - Autobattle[/h1] Taking everything you've learnt from turn based and throw it away, since this does not operate the same at all. [h2]2.1. Defense[/h2] Same issue from turn based but worse, pawn can block line of fire this time but you could also just ignore them by telling your pawn to target fire at the rear line....what's the point? Maybe only certain unit can target rear line like sniper and scout instead of anyone? [h2]2.2. Mechanic[/h2] Remeber reliability? This has zero effect on this mode, you should prioritise high stats for this mode polar opposite to the previous mode. It want you to have weapon dedicated for autobattle and turn based specifically for best effect. [h2]2.3. Pawn[/h2] Their class has no influence in this mode aside from choice of weapon, except for support class who can heal but that it. [h1]3. Conclusion[/h1] The turn based mode does not feel satisfying to play at all, it, you don't need to plan it just a dice roll whether you win or not, The autobattle is fine maybe a bit boring, it just you trying to DPS the enemy team to death.

[h1] PAWN OF WAR：点子和硬伤一样多 [/h1] 免费的战棋游戏，卖点是像素风，少女与军武。我玩了大概15个小时，简单总结了一下这游戏的现况： [h2] 剧情 [/h2] 我不知道是我这里有BUG还是游戏确实没做出来，序章讲的是在未来大战再次爆发，而你作为一名士兵要活下去并找出真相，随后就没有了。此外还有活动剧情，加州的小女孩作为小队医疗兵与小队成员执行任务，阴差阳错的闯入了未知地点，不得已干掉了遭到夺舍的队友后被主线序章主角所救。流水线模板小故事，很容易就能猜出剧情走向，平庸但合格，照此来看以后剧情也出不了大问题，要是能多点反转或者剧情深度就更好了。 [h2] 画面与UI [/h2] 像素风格没什么好说的，大问题出在UI上。UI和画面很粗糙，就像大学生毕设一样，文本框很小不说排版还只排了一行，一旦字数变多字体就会很小，浏览困难。人员武器的编辑界面用了大量的符号，但是这些符号没有明确的解释，导致我不得不通过挨个试来弄明白每个符号是什么意思。同一个页面内打开的不同栏还会互相干扰影响操作和查看，还有按钮失灵的BUG。 [h2] 玩法 [/h2] 目前来看，游戏的主线与活动采用的是完全不一样的玩法，虽然都为选择人员后交战，但是活动任务的玩法更贴近于“战棋”，指挥角色根据给出的顺序采取不同行动在地图内达成诸如全歼敌人的目标，每回合行动次数有限需要费点心思考虑；主线任务的玩法元素就粗暴多了，选择人员配装，丢进地图里跟对面磕枪。几乎没有任何对局内的决策，唯一要考虑的就是可有可无的放弃攻击换防御，胜率全看DPS与耐久。每日任务更不用说，极致的DPS就是胜率。活动支线则是整出了自己选配装之后进活动战棋的第三种玩法，诸如火箭筒，近战，盾牌之类的特殊武器只有这种模式下才有的体现。此外这几种玩法每一次对局都是随机的，难度大小全看这次随机到的回合情况，活动任务运气好开局连着五六个回合全是玩家的，一枪都不挨就能全歼对面；运气差连着几个回合全是对面，你根本没有操作机会就被对面绞杀了，这就导致了你的局内决策也起不了多大作用，这一点扣大分！！ 此外，对局外还存在着限制干员，枪械总数这种我看不懂的操作，干员数值令人生疑，没有常规认知中“盾兵，机枪手血厚狙击手侦察兵血少”的情况需要自行分辨，而一些干员自身数值不错却由于职业限制拿不了长枪导致适用范围极小难以上场，诸如此类问题还有一些。枪械方面，仓库容量太小了，一旦觉得“这枪有点意思我先留着”，很快仓库就满了，不得不清理；枪械和零件的数值平衡类似跷跷板，必须以一方面数值暴跌为代价换取另一方数值暴涨，等等。看制作组后续会如何调整。 [b] 此外，还有交互失效BUG，成就BUG等。虽然都不大但是挺影响游戏心态，希望制作组多注意。 [/b] [h3] 综合来看，能看出制作组是有不少想法的，就看他们有没有能力将这些想法转换成现实了。大大小小的BUG也暂时视作新作品未经打磨的问题，酌情给个好评。我也将根据后续继续修改测评 [/h3]

A youtuber once said that the main problem with most indie fps games is that they focus on the guns first and focus on the game itself second. And that statement seems to apply to this game as well. This game has 74 guns and 300+ attachments for those guns. There are 19 "Pawns" (excluding the grunts) who don't really have anything special to them except for their skill. So with all of this mentioned, what does the gameplay look like? As mentioned in other reviews, it's either RNG or an idle-sim with a few clicks in between. The turn-based mode could either be the easiest thing ever or a level that makes you restart over 10+ times. At the time of this review (July 7th, 2026), I played through the Locator event (But the previous event is locked for some reason???) and most levels were absolute bollocks because the enemies would either have more turns than me or I was given pawns that wouldn't be useful to me during that turn. I won a level once because the enemy A.I. bugged out so I was able to get free hits on it. There are other problems such as not knowing which enemy is going to attack, losing a point even though your pawn didn't complete the action, bad movement spaces, etc. The idle-sim mode is the grind part of the game; You click on a spot on the map depending on what you want (ex. money, pawn XP, weapons XP, random pawn, and random weapon). This mode has two interesting mechanics: being the target-on-enemy and shield. At first, it's nice when you're starting out, but as you get more pawns and weapons, the only useful thing is the lock-on feature which EVEN THEN is still not used that much. I would say that grinding is the worst part in any game, especially in gacha game. But what makes grinding at least bearable in most games is that the gameplay is fun, this one gets boring after a while. And something else that bothered me was that this game seems to take inspiration from Girls' Frontline (good game) in it's gameplay but seems to not understand why that worked. The "idle" parts in GFL was a small fight within a larger, more strategic battle. You had to check your T-dolls' ammo, health, firepower, etc. before going into the next fight. But in POW, the idle part is, just like what another player said, a DPS match. Have a team with good DPS & EVA and you're good. Even with all of its flaws, this game has potential, but the devs are just putting their efforts into something else. Gameplay first, THEN customization. I will still check out this game from time to time, but I can't really recommend this game to anyone at the moment. Maybe I'll change my review when the game gets better.

So, first off, I really dig the military theme—right up my alley. The story and art style are pretty solid too. But here's the thing: I'm pretty sure the game uses way more AI than what the store page admits (they just said 'some backgrounds'), so take that 'compliment' however you want—I'll let you decide if that's a good thing or not. Now for the flaws. Oh boy. The mission descriptions in Simplified Chinese are tiny. Like, pixelated to the point where the text just turns into a blurry mess. The UI is terrible—both the main menu and the battle screen. It's just uncomfortable to look at and clunky to use. It's an auto-battler, but the RNG is insane. Sometimes battles feel completely ridiculous, and getting that 'perfect' rating (all three conditions met) is way harder than it should be. This is not a hands-off idle game. You have to keep clicking and tapping constantly. And why on earth does an idle game have a gacha system?! I get it—they were trying to go for that anime RPG vibe, but seriously, it's totally unnecessary. Drop rates are awful, and there's no pity system. I've literally only pulled one purple weapon from the gacha; the rest I just farmed from grinding levels. Oh, and the character upgrade screen? More clicking. Like, seriously?! Honestly, this game has zero real gameplay value. If you're just curious and want a quick taste, give it a shot—but don't expect to stick around for long. It's just not worth it.
